name: Joppa

related_people.name: Simon
related_people.role: the tanner in whose house by the sea Peter lodged and saw the vision of the sheet

related_people.name: Tabitha
related_people.role: a disciple full of good works whom Peter raised from the dead here

description: A coastal port town where Peter raised the disciple Tabitha (Dorcas) from the dead and later, staying with Simon the tanner, received the rooftop vision opening the gospel to Gentiles (Acts 9:36-43; 10:9-23).
